rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_requirements.description: Handsome tall strongly built elderly Assamese man in white clothes riding horse, native-quote garments
Anger at harming dwelling tree; offending woodcutter suffering bodily ailment without magic beams
Tall dwelling tree kept clean in Assamese folk context
Respectful religious spirit bearing, not terrifying monster

artistic_choices: Read full c04 Assamese quote: white dhoti/shirt/shawl and Mathura-style turban, not imported divine crown.
Tall strong stature does not mean giant; rider and horse remain natural scale.
Painful shoulder and dropped axe are restrained editorial depiction of nonspecific bodily ailment, no invented spell mechanism or gore.
Full-blossomed rose c08 is descriptive comparison, not literal flower anatomy.
Rearing horse and low camera amplify reverent authority; horse color and sunset editorial.
Final attempt uses forceful mounted arrival and explicit commanding gesture to express sourced anger c05 without inventing a spell.
Ordinary fallen lamp is editorial lighting, not a divine attribute; travel wind/dust are physical motion effects only.
Afflicted offender is placed behind separated tree trunk so bodily ailment c10 cannot read as trampling or horse accident.

No selected image after three attempts: respectful documented humanlike horse-rider form did not reach Sangar without unsupported changes. All generated native PNGs and exact prompts/provenance archived.

rejected_attempts.reason: Native and 200px: sourced iconography and shoulder pain are present, but bright daytime naturalism reads ordinary elderly horse rider; spirit face too small and horse alone carries imposing presence. Fails Sangar items2/7.
Root Codex viewed native+200: ordinary elderly rider in white on natural horse, calm face and neutral seating; injured man reads horse accident. Fails §6.1/§6.4 item7.

Root Codex viewed native+200: §6.4 item7 remains ordinary white-clothed elderly rider holding halt palm; rider/horse forceful but not unmistakable spirit. Cannot add unsupported features or size to force it.

reason: Tiga percobaan native+200px tetap terbaca sebagai pria tua berpakaian putih menunggang kuda biasa, meskipun mencoba pembelaan pohon, bodily ailment, framing dekat, cahaya low-key dan gerak memerintah. Klaim c02/c04/c07/c08 mendukung rupa pria tampan bertubuh tinggi-kuat dengan pakaian putih dan kuda; c05/c10 mendukung kemarahan/penderitaan tubuh, tetapi tidak mendukung anatomi pembeda, ukuran raksasa, halo, fitur hantu atau mekanisme sihir. Menambah fitur tersebut demi memenuhi Sangar akan mengarang. Ketiga PNG, prompt dan provenance disimpan; decline mengikuti GAMBAR §4/§6.4 setelah maksimal3percobaan.
